title: LA PASTÈQUE EN PRISON 🍉

scenes.image: A huge muscular prisoner with a giant watermelon head and an angry face, in a striped prison uniform, walks toward the camera in a prison cafeteria; prisoners with fruit heads (orange, pear, pineapple, apple) watch, guards on the balcony.

lines.say: Dans cette prison, tout le monde a peur de la Pastèque.

scenes.image: In the prison cafeteria, the giant watermelon-head prisoner grabs the food tray of a small, scared prisoner with a red apple head; close-up on both, dramatic tension.
An old, calm but tough prisoner with a pineapple head and a grey beard stands up from his table and points at the watermelon-head prisoner, the whole cafeteria goes silent.

lines.say: Rends-lui son plateau. Tout de suite.

scenes.image: Wide shot: dozens of fruit-head prisoners all stand up together behind the pineapple and the apple, facing the watermelon-head prisoner who looks suddenly nervous and sweating.

lines.say: Ce jour-là, la Pastèque a compris qu'on ne touche pas aux plus petits.

caption:
🍉 Le caïd de la prison s'en prend au plus petit… mauvaise idée 😳

Tu aurais fait quoi à la place de l'Ananas ? 👇
Partie 2 ?
